KPI_1.name: M1 Opportunities Created Count for New and Existing Customers (Non-Closed Won)
KPI_1.description: Tracks the count of M1 stage opportunities created for both new and existing customers, excluding closed won deals with positive ACV.

KPI_2.name: M1 Starting ACV for New and Existing Customers (Non-Closed Won)
KPI_2.description: Measures the total starting Annual Contract Value for M1 stage opportunities from both new and existing customers, excluding closed won deals.

KPI_3.name: S0 Opportunities Created Count for New and Existing Customers (Non-Closed Won)
KPI_3.description: Tracks the count of S0 stage opportunities created for both new and existing customers, excluding closed won deals with positive ACV.

KPI_4.name: S0 Starting ACV for New and Existing Customers (Non-Closed Won)
KPI_4.description: Measures the total starting Annual Contract Value for S0 stage opportunities from both new and existing customers, excluding closed won deals.

KPI_5.name: S1 Opportunities Created Count for New and Existing Customers (Non-Closed Won)
KPI_5.description: Tracks the count of S1 stage opportunities created for both new and existing customers, excluding closed won deals with positive ACV.

KPI_6.name: S1 Starting ACV for New and Existing Customers (Non-Closed Won)
KPI_6.description: Measures the total starting Annual Contract Value for S1 stage opportunities from both new and existing customers, excluding closed won deals.

KPI_7.name: S1 Opportunities Created Count with Team Filter
KPI_7.description: Tracks S1 stage opportunity creation count for new and existing customers with valid creator team assignments, excluding closed won deals.

KPI_8.name: S0 Starting ACV with Team Filter
KPI_8.description: Measures total starting ACV for S0 stage opportunities from new and existing customers with valid creator team assignments, excluding closed won deals.

KPI_9.name: M1 Opportunities Created Count with Team Filter
KPI_9.description: Tracks M1 stage opportunity creation count for new and existing customers with valid creator team assignments, excluding closed won deals.

KPI_10.name: Total Opportunity ACV for New and Existing Customers (Non-Closed Won)
KPI_10.description: Measures total Annual Contract Value for opportunities from both new and existing customers with positive ACV, excluding closed won deals.

attributes: Opportunity Type, Opportunity Stage, Opportunity Creator Profile, Opportunity Source Detailed, Opportunity Creator Team
goal: Monitor sales pipeline generation and early-stage opportunity creation to track lead qualification progress and revenue potential across different time periods.
user_context: Sales managers and revenue operations teams use this dashboard during weekly and monthly pipeline review meetings to track opportunity creation performance across different sales stages (M1, S0, S1), analyzing both deal count and ACV metrics by individual contributors, teams, and lead sources to identify top performers, assess pipeline health, spot trends in opportunity progression, and make data-driven decisions about resource allocation while comparing current week performance against historical periods to understand velocity and conversion patterns.
